name: Niji-iro Suishou
source:
One day main character buys an old box at a small antique shop. Inside is a transparent dice and a figure of a girl. Suddenly figure starts to talk. She turns out to be fairy Norn who is able to change the fate. From this day life fills with novelty and excitement.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一天，主人公在一家小古董店买下一只旧盒子，里面装着一枚透明骰子和一个少女人偶。人偶突然开口说话；原来她是能够改变命运的妖精诺恩。从这一天起，主人公的生活充满了新奇与刺激。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
